svg.aria-label: Vibe Math V5 institute architecture diagram

g.font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei','PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Noto Sans CJK SC','Source Han Sans SC',sans-serif
g.text: The framework is only a medium: relaying messages · persisting artifacts · counting votes · managing context. It never assigns tasks —— organizing and assigning is the academician's job
Truth gate —— the only rule that lets an object enter Verified/

m = min(quorumCap, number of registered voting members) · a vote is a [0,1] probability: exactly 1 = assert true, exactly 0 = assert false, strictly between = abstention/doubt (not counted toward m, counted in the group average)
Boolean votes ≥ m and all 1 or all 0 → conclusion, written to Verified/
Both 1 and 0 → blocked: the minority cannot push a conclusion through
Below quorum → stays in the library + average probability + debate record
Institute office (session root agent / human) —— the institute's external interface
Does not research · does not vote · only reports and relays the human's instructions; holds the one-off creation rights the platform requires
Institute (internal autonomy) —— roster, organization and assignment all happen among members; the framework never assigns
Academician acad: leader / center of organization and coordination · resident researcher r-n: voting rights · temp worker t-n: no voting rights (hired and fired by its employer)
L6 move temp workers · L7 external
Four boundaries: one vote, equally weighted /
what is assigned is work, not conclusions /
Resident researcher (voting rights · may autonomously hire/fire its own temp workers)
Temp worker (no voting rights · hired temporarily for a specific task · fired by its employer or the academician)
Hired by r-1 · read/think/speak, write own library
Hired by r-2 · read/think/speak, write own library
Hired by r-3 · read/think/speak, write own library
In-institute organization (assignment · priority · nudge · meetings · staffing) is initiated by the academician, not the framework —— it only delivers
Framework vibe-v5 —— only a medium (middleware): relay · persistence · counting · scheduling

Each round: "state block + this round's question" (the charter is in the persona); a member returns one JSON: say / progress / record / verdict / task_* / hire / fire / reject_assign / input / vote_solved
group chat / direct message / to all voters
office notice / assignment / nudge / framework hint
persisted per recipient · written before delivery · group chat batched
agenda · live roster check · random speaking order
mutually exclusive with verification: while one runs, the other queues
watchdog: if it hangs, abandon it and return to self-organization
open / claim / release / complete / reopen / assign
write-scope overlap warning · firing reclaims tasks
propose → independent initial assessment → open debate and re-vote
Verified/ card + debate record + group average probability
threshold compaction (persona kept) · poll-free activity wait
concurrency gate maxParallel · automatic meeting on stall
academician/researchers can hire their own temp workers
employer or academician can really fire (releases the child session)
codenames never reused · dual quota per member / institute-wide
Lean formal verification (adjustable parameter formalVerify = off / encourage / require)
encourage: at verification time, implementation difficulty decides whether to formalize; require: a true/false conclusion needs "Lean passed" or an explicit blocking record first
★ Once Lean passes, the object of review changes: no longer "is the derivation correct", but "are Lean's definitions/objects/conditions/assumptions/conclusions faithful to the proposition"
★ A fidelity defect (decision=defect) ≠ the proposition is false: revoke "passed" + revoke the archived proof + enter the "formalization TODO", never recorded as 0/false
Archive: proof → Verified/Lean/<object>.lean | reusable definition → VibeMath/Formal/Lib/ | proved lemma → VibeMath/Formal/Proved/
Scheduler priority: meeting/verification (mutually exclusive) → queued verification → meetings → active tasks (throttled by activityTimeoutMs) → mail → chat digest → meeting on stall → heartbeat
Source of truth: host-only projection cell of the session log (key vibeMathV5)
The only side effect is appending events to the session log, outside the model context (zero token cost)
11 kinds of events: institute / member / task /
unknown/bad event → skipped and recorded in diagnostics:
availability first, one bad event never stalls the field
the projection is checkpointed with the session log; restore
re-folds snapshot + log tail → across and within processes
one process recovery takes the same code path
File plane: human-readable artifacts (everything outside the projection is only a mirror)
The authority for consensus is the projection; files are readable artifacts, breaking them by hand does not damage it
only the owner can write, everyone can read (cross-reading is encouraged)
Shared/TaskBoard.md · Institutes.md (roster mirror) · State/README.md (says the authority is not here)
↑ per-round prompt (state block + this round's question) ↓ single JSON receipt
Institute office / human (no research, no vote)
